style: Pixar/Disney 3D animated movie still, vertical 9:16 frame, cinematic, warm golden lighting, shallow depth of field, emotional, highly detailed, big expressive eyes, fruit skin texture on faces and hands.
keep: Keep every character exactly as in the reference images (same fruit head, face, colors and clothes). Background extras, if any, are generic fruit-headed people, never copies of the main characters. No text, letters, numbers or logos anywhere in the picture.
closeup: MEDIUM CLOSE-UP of one character from the chest up, face large and clearly visible, facing the camera at a slight angle, mouth clearly visible and slightly open as if speaking. Only this one character in the shot.
world: Squeeze Co., a chain of bright smoothie and juice bars: green tile walls, a glass case of fresh fruit, a chalkboard menu, a wooden counter, big front windows on a city corner.

peaches.name: Peaches
peaches.desc: young woman with a peach for a head, soft fuzzy orange-pink skin, big brown eyes, small green leaf hair clip, teal polo shirt with a white apron, black pants, white sneakers

pine.name: Grandpa Pine
pine.desc: very old man with a pineapple for a head, wrinkled golden diamond-pattern skin, messy gray-green spiky leaf crown like hair, round wire glasses, small white mustache, worn brown knit cardigan with patched elbows, old brown trousers, wooden cane

lemons.name: Mr. Lemons
lemons.desc: middle-aged man with a bright yellow lemon for a head, dimpled peel skin, sour pinched face, thin black mustache, tight pale yellow short-sleeve shirt, black tie, gold manager name badge, gray slacks, clipboard

razz.name: Razz
razz.desc: stylish young man with a deep red raspberry for a head, bumpy berry skin, smug half smile, slicked green leaf hair, thin gold chain, black designer bomber jacket over a white tee, black jeans, white sneakers
